verses.text: Hallelu YAH! For [it is] good to praise our God—how pleasant [and] beautiful [is] praise!

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! For [it is] good to praise our God—how pleasant [and] beautiful [is] praise!

verses.text: The One building up Jerusalem [is] YHWH, [and] He gathers together the exiles of Israel,

segments.text: The One building up Jerusalem [is] YHWH, [and] He gathers together the exiles of Israel,

verses.text: giving healing to the broken of heart, and binding up their wounds,

segments.text: giving healing to the broken of heart, and binding up their wounds,

verses.text: Appointing the number of the stars—for all of them He calls by names.

segments.text: Appointing the number of the stars—for all of them He calls by names.

verses.text: Great [is] our Lord, and abundant in power; of His understanding there is no numbering!

segments.text: Great [is] our Lord, and abundant in power; of His understanding there is no numbering!

verses.text: YHWH restores the humble; He casts down the wicked to the ground.

segments.text: YHWH restores the humble; He casts down the wicked to the ground.

verses.text: Sing to YHWH with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the harp,

segments.text: Sing to YHWH with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the harp,

verses.text: [to] the One covering the heavens with clouds, the One preparing rain for the earth, the One making grass sprout on the hills,

segments.text: [to] the One covering the heavens with clouds, the One preparing rain for the earth, the One making grass sprout on the hills,

verses.text: giving to the beast its food, [and] to the young of the ravens that call out.

segments.text: giving to the beast its food, [and] to the young of the ravens that call out.

verses.text: He does not delight in the strength of the horse, and not in the legs of the man does He take pleasure.

segments.text: He does not delight in the strength of the horse, and not in the legs of the man does He take pleasure.

verses.text: YHWH is pleased with those who fear him, those hoping in His loving devotion.

segments.text: YHWH is pleased with those who fear him, those hoping in His loving devotion.

verses.text: Exalt, O Jerusalem, YHWH; praise your God, O Zion!

segments.text: Exalt, O Jerusalem, YHWH; praise your God, O Zion!

verses.text: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your sons within you.

segments.text: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your sons within you.

verses.text: The One making peace [for] your border, He satisfies you with the fat of wheat.

segments.text: The One making peace [for] your border, He satisfies you with the fat of wheat.

verses.text: The One sending forth His utterance [to] the earth, how swiftly His word runs!

segments.text: The One sending forth His utterance [to] the earth, how swiftly His word runs!

verses.text: The One giving snow like wool, He scatters the frost like ashes,

segments.text: The One giving snow like wool, He scatters the frost like ashes,

verses.text: casting forth His hail like morsels; before the face of His cold, who can stand?

segments.text: casting forth His hail like morsels; before the face of His cold, who can stand?

verses.text: He sends out His word and melts them; His wind he makes blow, [and] the waters flow.

segments.text: He sends out His word and melts them; His wind he makes blow, [and] the waters flow.

verses.text: He declares His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

segments.text: He declares His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

verses.text: He has not done so for any nation; and His judgments they have not known. Praise YAH!
